in_greek.name: Ἑῖος
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'heis', which means 'one', 'alone', 'single'. The name 'Heyes' in Greek would mean 'one who is a guest' or 'one who is a foreigner'. In the New Testament, this name is borne by several characters, including Heyes the centurion in Matthew 8:5-13.
